name: Sidekick Pro
notes: Always-on assistant for solo business owners and small teams that watches Gmail, Calendar and its own phone line, texts alerts and a daily brief, answers calls as a receptionist, joins meetings and automates browser tasks through a Chrome extension. Requested via the form (issue #189).

access.price: Plus $20/mo, Business $29/mo, Ultra $200/mo; new accounts get $5 usage credit, no card
